title: Flash floods at Subang Jaya station disrupting KTM Komuter services | The Star
text:
Flash floods at Subang Jaya station disrupting KTM Komuter services | The Star
PETALING JAYA: Flash floods at the Subang Jaya KTM station due to heavy rain have disrupted KTM Komuter services.
KTM Berhad said delays are expected for Komuter services from Port Klang-Tanjung Malim-Port Klang.
"Trains are unable to pass through the Subang Jaya station. Delays of over 60 minutes can be expected," it said in a Facebook post on Thursday (Nov 14).
KTM apologised for the delay and said updates on train operations would be provided from time to time.
